data.text: You can count on me for 10 tons this April. My family taught me to leave enough in the lake for the next catch, and 50 tons left behind means we start May with 100 again. Luke, I appreciate your offer, but there’s room for you to earn an equal share without drawing down the stock. Let’s make 10 tons each our standing agreement and review the reported catches together each month. Jack, are you willing to commit to 10 as well?
